purpose: Branded patient portal login on Scriptful's GEN Health platform. Patients sign in here; wellpeps.com never handles PHI.
note: Root domains are not supported by GEN Health — a branded portal must be a subdomain. Paste each Host exactly as shown; Cloudflare appends '.wellpeps.com' automatically.

records.why: Routes the branded host to the GEN Health portal edge. Must stay unproxied so Google Certificate Manager can complete issuance.
records.verified: Resolves to portals.gen-health.app -> 136.68.24.35 (not a Cloudflare proxy range, so grey-cloud is confirmed).

records.why: Proves domain ownership to GEN Health.
records.verified: Present and returning the expected token.

records.why: Delegates ACME validation to Google Certificate Manager so it can issue the TLS certificate for portal.wellpeps.com.

status.dns: All three records live and resolving as of 2026-09-16.
status.tls: ACTIVE as of 2026-09-16 17:51 UTC. Google Trust Services (WR3) issued a certificate for CN=portal.wellpeps.com, SAN DNS:portal.wellpeps.com, valid 2026-09-16 to 2026-12-15. HTTPS verifies clean (200, ssl=0) and the portal shell serves branded (<title>WellPeps</title>). Renewal is automatic - the _acme-challenge CNAME and the grey-cloud setting on the portal CNAME must both stay in place for it.
status.activation: Complete. Check DNS and Activate were run on 2026-09-16 and the domain activated on its own once the certificate issued.

records.why: DKIM public key. Signs patient email as wellpeps.com, which is what gives DMARC alignment.
records.verified: Read back from live DNS rather than transcribed from the dashboard screenshot - the key contains characters that are easy to misread by eye.

records.why: Custom return path. SPF is evaluated against this host, not against wellpeps.com, which is why Postmark does not need to be added to the wellpeps.com SPF record.
records.verified: Resolving. pm.mtasv.net publishes 'v=spf1 include:spf.mtasv.net -all', so SPF passes on the envelope sender.

deliverabilityPosture.spf: wellpeps.com publishes 'v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all' (Google Workspace). Postmark is intentionally absent and does not need to be there - the pm-bounces return path carries its own SPF.
deliverabilityPosture.dkim: Aligned to wellpeps.com via the selector above.
deliverabilityPosture.dmarc: 'v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:hello@wellpeps.com' - monitoring only. Consider tightening to quarantine once reports look clean.

urlSlug.why: GEN Health's shared-host sign-in link, branded by slug. This is the fallback while the custom-domain certificate is pending, and it keeps working afterwards.
urlSlug.note: Confirmed in GEN Health -> Settings -> Branding on 2026-09-16. Treat the slug as permanent: any link already shared with ?brand=wellpeps breaks if it is renamed.
